name: tools-levelmusic-utility-v1-3
title: LevelMusic Utility v1.3.2
description:
LevelMusic is a custom level music bypass that covers for the two main issues with the standard Music Bypass feature in Lunar Magic:
  • Custom music does not work with mode 7 bosses.
  • The music does not fade between levels that have different music.
LevelMusic, on the other hand, has neither of these limitations.

This Utility allows you to apply, reconfigure, and remove LevelMusic without boring you with the nitty gritty details; changing level music is now convenient and can be done without even leaving Lunar Magic.

This Utility requires the .NET Framework 2.0 or higher.

See the readme for instructions on how to add this to your Lunar Magic toolbar.

The latest update adds an option to export your ROM's LevelMusic table whenever it is modified; this update simplifies porting hacks that use LevelMusic to a clean ROM.
